label: Shape Intelligence — Critique and Synthesis
goal: Build independent critique and synthesis for provisional Shape candidates.
purpose: Challenge proposed meaning before it is persisted as an accepted candidate and reconcile defensible alternatives.
success_condition: A separate critic and synthesizer expose unsupported abstraction, scope errors, missing negative evidence, and duplicate-like candidates before acceptance.
objectives: Define independent critic and synthesizer identities.
Require alternative hypotheses and negative evidence.
scope_out: Semantic equivalence asserted solely by heuristics.
